article.headline: Mason Williams, Tyler Powell guide Eastern Washington to 72-67 victory over Portland State
article.description: — Mason Williams and Tyler Powell scored 17 points apiece to lead Eastern Washington to a 72-67 victory over Portland State on Saturday.
article.linkText: Mason Williams, Tyler Powell guide Eastern Washington to 72-67 victory over Portland State
article.story: CHENEY, Wash. -- — Mason Williams and Tyler Powell scored 17 points apiece to lead Eastern Washington to a 72-67 victory over Portland State on Saturday. Williams added six rebounds for the Eagles (9-16, 5-7 Big Sky Conference). Elijah Thomas had nine points. The Vikings (14-10, 6-5) were led by Jaylin Henderson with 19 points and four steals. Tre-Vaughn Minott totaled 16 points, 13 rebounds, three steals and four blocks. Isaiah Johnson added 16 points and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
